title: 1RB1LC_1RC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE0LD_1LF---_0RA1LA: the run from blank tape proved to level 2, every reset at a nearly empty tail in Lean
text: From blank tape the machine reaches (17, 0, 6805) at step 374,475,636 and then, without halting, the first record of level 2 after more than 10<sup>1543</sup> steps, with a 772-digit n. Every reset at the nearly empty tails 1001, 1 and 1001101011001 is a Lean rule for every n: one class halts (n = 0 or 9 mod 10 at (n, 0, 6)), 14 never halt.
